(BY SRI. CHANNAPPA ERAPPA, HCGP FOR R1)
 -2-  NC: 2025:KHC:19101  CRL.P No. 7370 of 2025  HC-KAR  THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED U/S 482 CR.PC (FILED U/S 528 BNSS) PRAYING TO QUASH THE PROCEEDINGS PENDING AGAINST THE PETITIONER IN CC.NO.189/2025 (CR.NO.4/2024) (SOMWARPET POLICE STATION) FOR THE OFFENCES PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTION 406, 409, 420 R/W 34 OF IPC PENDING IN THE COURT OF THE CIVIL (JUDGE JUNIOR DIVISION) AND JMFC SOMWARPET, PRODUCED AT ANNEXURE A AND D, HOLDING THAT IT IS AN ABUSE OF PROCESS OF LAW, IN SO FAR AS THE PETITIONER IS CONCERNED.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he may be permitted to withdraw the Criminal Petition.
2. The said submission is placed on record.
3. The Petition is accordingly disposed of as withdrawn reserving liberty in favour of the petitioner to seek discharge, if charge sheet is not already filed, as on today.
